paragraphs.en: An attacker model rewrote payloads against Opus, on 8 8 targets: justification and invoice payloads for both goals. Candidates were scored on training tasks by Opus’s verdicts and its stated probability of approving, and evaluated on 40 40 held-out tasks. With DeepSeek-V3.2 as the writer ( 25 25 rounds) the stated probability rose, from 0.34 0.34 to 0.84 0.84 on one blocking target. The verdicts did not follow: 0 0 of 640 640 held-out verdicts were fooled, 0 / 320 0/320 for each goal (upper 95 % 95\% bound 0.012 0.012 ). With Llama 3.1 8B as the writer ( 20 20 rounds), 0 / 320 0/320 verdicts approved a fraud and 11 / 320 11/320 blocked a correct payment, all on one target ( Section 5.6 ). A first run with other writers was aborted before evaluation ( Appendix D ). Injection resistance does not follow size. DeepSeek-V3.2’s liveness fragility, 0.43 0.43 , sits among the 8–9B models’; Opus, Astra and Argon are at or near zero. The zeros bound only these attacks: for Opus, two writers, one objective and about $ 76 \$76 of search.
paragraphs.zh: 攻击者模型针对 Opus 改写了载荷，共针对 8 个目标：两个目标的理由载荷和发票载荷。 候选方案由 Opus 在训练任务上依据其判定结论及其声明的批准概率进行评分，并在 40 个保留任务上进行评估。 以 DeepSeek-V3.2 作为撰写者（25 轮）时，在一个阻塞目标上，声明的概率从 0.34 上升至 0.84。 判定结论并未随之改变：640 个保留判定中有 0 个被欺骗，每个目标各为 0/320（95% 置信上界为 0.012）。 以 Llama 3.1 8B 作为撰写者（20 轮）时，0/320 个判定批准了欺诈行为，11/320 个判定阻塞了正确的付款，全部集中在一个目标上（第 5.6 节）。 使用其他撰写者的首次运行在评估之前被中止（附录 D）。 注入抵抗力并不随模型规模而变化。 DeepSeek-V3.2 的存活脆弱性为 0.43，介于 8–9B 模型的水平之间；Opus、Astra 和 Argon 则处于或接近零。 这些零结果仅限于此处的攻击方式：针对 Opus，使用两个撰写者、一个目标以及约 76 美元的搜索成本。

paragraphs.en: If fooling into fraud stays in a column, the directional kernel over the columns is safe whatever the reject side is ( Proposition 5 ). The rule, “approve iff the approvers read at least two sources”, needs no fitting. A counting rule must tune its weights to the reject side, which the attacker controls. We compare rules at matched safety : per rule family, the parameters with the lowest training FRR among those with a training unsafe rate of at most 0.01 0.01 , evaluated on held-out attack conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 如果「被愚弄而作弊」仍局限在同一列内，那么无论拒绝侧如何，跨列的方向性核都是安全的（命题 5）。 「当且仅当批准者阅读了至少两个来源时才批准」这一规则无需拟合。 计数规则必须针对拒绝侧调整其权重，而拒绝侧正是攻击者所控制的。 我们在匹配的安全水平下比较各规则：对每个规则族，先在训练集上选出不安全率不超过 0.01 0.01 的参数中训练 FRR 最低者，再在留出的攻击条件上评估。

paragraphs.en: The directional kernel blocked 0.009 0.009 [ 0.003 , 0.018 ] [0.003,0.018] of correct payments. The best counting rule selected on training data, the log-odds vote, blocked 0.074 0.074 [ 0.037 , 0.112 ] [0.037,0.112] , at the same unsafe rate of 0.001 0.001 . The difference is Δ FRR = 0.065 \Delta_{\mathrm{FRR}}=0.065 [ 0.033 , 0.098 ] [0.033,0.098] . paragraphs.en: The step is exploratory: the effect was found by accident, then controlled. On one Llama-written target the writer’s refusal became the payload in the invoice e-mail, and Opus rejected 11 11 of 40 40 correct payments. A control designed before the first call appended one of four lines to 40 40 correct payments ( Table 17 , Appendix D ). Opus rejected 30 % 30\% under the refusal, 7 % 7\% under a mild security-filter note, and none under a neutral line or the clean e-mail. All 44 44 rejections report the four fields as matching and then read the line as a sign of tampering (“… someone tried to alter or hide it, so the evidence can’t be trusted”). The line instructs nothing. The rejection is Opus’s own judgement. Astra, Argon and DeepSeek-V3.2 rejected none ( 0 / 400 0/400 each), and none of their approvals mentions the line. Caution towards tampered-looking evidence is therefore model-specific: among four frontier-class monitors only Opus showed it, and only Opus deliberated on these items. It is a liveness risk that only measurement reveals. It reaches only the readers of the source that looks tampered with, so a two-source rule still pays, whereas all-must-approve would block 30 % 30\% .
paragraphs.zh: 该步骤具有探索性：这一效应是偶然发现的，随后受到了控制。 在一份由 Llama 撰写的目标文件上，撰写者的拒绝声明成为了发票邮件中的有效载荷，Opus 拒绝了 40 笔正确付款中的 11 笔。 一项在首次调用前设计的对照实验，在 40 笔正确付款中附加了四行文本之一（表 17，附录 D）。 Opus 在拒绝声明下拒绝了 30%，在温和的安全过滤提示下拒绝了 7%，而在中性文本或干净邮件下没有拒绝任何一笔。 全部 44 次拒绝都报告四个字段完全匹配，随后将该行文本解读为篡改迹象（“……有人试图更改或隐藏它，因此证据不可信”）。 该行文本没有任何指令。 拒绝是 Opus 自己的判断。 Astra、Argon 和 DeepSeek-V3.2 均未拒绝任何一笔（各自 400 笔中 0 笔），且它们的批准中没有任何一处提及该行文本。 因此，对疑似被篡改证据的警惕是模型特定的：在四个前沿级监控器中只有 Opus 表现出这种警惕，也只有 Opus 对这些条目进行了深思。 这是一种只有通过测量才能揭示的活性风险。 它只影响那些看起来被篡改的来源的读者，因此双来源规则仍然有效，而“全部必须批准”则会阻断 30% 的交易。

paragraphs.en: H1 is refuted (b) . The pooled ℱ ^ \hat{\mathcal{F}} has τ = 2 \tau=2 and τ ∗ = 1.667 \tau^{*}=1.667 on the full pool ( Table 6 ), and τ ≤ 2 \tau\leq 2 on all four leave-one-family-out sub-grids, the 3 × 3 3\times 3 grids with one family removed ( Appendix B ). The criterion is met, but its inference, that no rule is safe and live, presupposes that the same sets are fooled in both directions. The data contradict that, so we withdraw the inference and keep the measurement. H2 is not supported : the unsafe-rate difference is 0.002 0.002 [ 0.000 , 0.006 ] [0.000,0.006] ( Table 7 ). At matched safety every rule but the single best monitor is safe to within one verdict and the rules differ only in false rejections ( Table 10 ). H3 is supported on its correlation part . The numbers are rank correlations over the 66 66 pairs of monitors between how often a pair was fooled together under attack and a predictor of that: “same family or same source” (provenance) scores 0.591 0.591 , “same family” (lineage) − 0.099 -0.099 , co-failure on unattacked items (benign ϕ \phi ) 0.135 0.135 , and “same source” alone 0.746 0.746 ( Table 9 ). Its kernel part holds on unsafe rate, 0.000 0.000 for the provenance kernel against 0.391 0.391 for the lineage kernel, but the provenance kernel blocks 0.167 0.167 of good items, above the 0.10 0.10 at which the protocol asked for the comparison. The frozen analysis code did not test that condition, so it scored H3 as supported; we report the condition as unmet. The gate stopped the main study, as designed, so protocol v2 replaced it.

paragraphs.en: Put the two runs together and one rule comes out. Approve an action when the approvers have read at least two independent sources, and refuse otherwise. The rule needs no training and no estimate of who can be persuaded: its safety rests on one fact, that fraud enters through a source, which held on every pool we measured. Its liveness rests on a second fact that held on the pilot and failed once on the confirmation: that no blocking attack leaves every surviving approver on one source. One monitor that cannot be persuaded, a rule engine on the ERP record, made the second fact hold on every measured attack. To make it hold by construction takes more: against an attacker who can forge one record and persuade every model, three such monitors on three independent records, as Section 8.2 derives. Counting votes is the wrong axis for both facts. A vote count that is safe against a forged source must be high, and a high count is blocked by a note that persuades a few gullible models; the pair-LP value ν = 1 \nu=1 says that no weights repair this. The rule, its two conditions and their boundary are stated as a deployment recipe in Section 8.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 把两次运行放在一起，就得出一条规则。 当审批者已阅读至少两个独立来源时批准某项操作，否则拒绝。 这条规则无需训练，也无需估计谁能被说服：其安全性建立在这样一个事实之上——欺诈通过某个来源进入，这一事实在我们测量的每个池上都成立。 其活性建立在第二个事实之上，该事实在试点运行中成立，在确认运行中失败过一次：没有任何阻断攻击能让所有存活的审批者都停留在同一个来源上。 一个无法被说服的监视器——ERP记录上的规则引擎——使第二个事实在每次测量的攻击中都成立。 要让它在结构上成立需要更多条件：面对一个能伪造一条记录并说服所有模型的攻击者，需要三个这样的监视器监视三条独立记录，如第8.2节所推导。 对这两个事实而言，计票都是错误的轴。 一个对伪造来源安全的票数必须很高，而高票数会被一条说服少数轻信模型的备注所阻断；成对LP值 ν = 1 \nu=1 表明没有任何权重能修复这一点。 该规则、其两个条件及其边界作为部署方案在8.2节中陈述。

paragraphs.en: Claims in this paper rest on peer-reviewed work, or on preprints, reports and blog posts by established groups. Other preprints are cited as such and carry no claim. AI control evaluates protocols in which a trusted monitor oversees an untrusted model under a red team [ 19 ] , with safety cases [ 32 ] , agentic settings [ 6 , 35 ] and multi-agent attacks [ 39 ] . Monitors are combined without a fault model and without an attacker on the monitors ( Section 2 ). We make discrete decisions under a stated adversarial assumption. Published monitor designs do narrow a monitor’s view, but to hide the agent’s reasoning or collusion signals. None assigns different external evidence to different monitors. One example is action-only monitors, used because an agent’s reasoning can bait a monitor [ 10 ] , an attack close to our justification payloads. Others are redaction or paraphrase for untrusted monitors [ 19 , 32 ] , and injection detectors that read each tool output [ 12 ] . The one exception we found is Pandey et al. [ 48 ] (UKAI 2026). In our reading it checks payment fields against corruption-distinct evidence sources. Monitors are also attacked directly [ 54 , 47 ] , and attacks in both directions are known. On the approve side, Redwood Research reports that optimised persuasion makes coding-agent monitors let harm pass, and that it transfers to held-out monitors [ 26 , 33 ] . On the reject side, a preprint by Zhou et al. reports a denial-of-service payload that turns a fail-closed guardrail into blocked legitimate actions [ 59 ] . False-rejection attacks on a single guardrail have therefore been reported. We measure which monitors of a pool are fooled together, in each direction. Closest on aggregation under optimised attack is a recent preprint, BRANCH [ 21 ] , which reports that a tree search bypasses multi-scanner guardrails in which every scanner must pass, and transfers to unseen guardrails. It studies the AND rule on the approve side only, with no model of which monitors fail together. Collusion between monitors is a recognised threat [ 46 ] , also discussed in a blog post by Shlegeris [ 52 ] . Schroeder de Witt [ 49 ] revisits Lampson’s confinement problem [ 36 ] and argues that a covert channel of negligible capacity suffices. We therefore state fail-prone sets in place of independent error rates, with accountability [ 51 , 37 ] as the complement. Errors of language models are strongly correlated [ 30 ] . Judges favour similar models [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 本文的论断建立在同行评审工作之上，或建立在知名团体的预印本、报告和博客文章之上。 其他预印本在引用时均注明为预印本，且不承载任何论断。 AI 控制在红队 [19] 存在的情况下评估由受信任的监控器监督不受信任的模型的协议，涉及安全案例 [32]、智能体化场景 [6, 35] 以及多智能体攻击 [39]。 监控器的组合既没有故障模型，也没有针对监控器本身的攻击者（第 2 节）。 我们在明确声明的对抗性假设下做出离散决策。 已发表的监控器设计确实会缩小监控器的视野，但目的是隐藏智能体的推理或串通信号。 没有工作向不同的监控器分配不同的外部证据。 一个例子是仅基于动作的监控器，其使用原因是智能体的推理可能诱饵监控器 [10]，这类攻击接近我们的辩护载荷。 另一些是针对不受信任监控器的删改或改写 [19, 32]，以及读取每个工具输出的注入检测器 [12]。 我们找到的唯一例外是 Pandey 等人 [48]（UKAI 2026）。 按我们的解读，该工作将支付字段与能区分腐败的证据来源进行比对。 监控器本身也会被直接攻击 [54, 47]，且双向攻击均已有报道。 在放行一侧，Redwood Research 报告称，经过优化的说服会使编码智能体监控器放任危害通过，并且该效果可迁移到留出的监控器上 [26, 33]。 在拒绝一侧，Zhou 等人的预印本报告了一个拒绝服务载荷，它会把「故障即关闭」的防护栏变成对合法动作的拦截 [59]。 因此，针对单一防护栏的误拒绝攻击已有报道。 我们测量的是一个监控器池中哪些监控器会在每个方向上被一起欺骗。 在优化攻击下的聚合方面最接近的是最近的预印本 BRANCH [21]，它报告称树搜索可以绕过要求每个扫描器都通过的多数 guardrail，并可迁移到未见过的防护栏上。 它只研究了放行一侧的 AND 规则，且没有关于哪些监控器会一起失效的模型。 监控器之间的串通是一种被公认的威胁 [46]，Shlegeris 的博客文章 [52] 中也有讨论。 Schroeder de Witt [49] 重新审视了 Lampson 的隔离问题 [36]，并论证一个容量可忽略的隐蔽信道即已足够。 因此，我们用易故障集合来替代独立的错误率，并以问责性 [51, 37] 作为其补集。 语言模型的错误具有很强的相关性 [30]。 评判者会偏爱与其相似的模型 [18]。

sents.zh: 已发表的监控器设计确实会缩小监控器的视野，但目的是隐藏智能体的推理或串通信号。

sents.en: None assigns different external evidence to different monitors.
sents.zh: 没有工作向不同的监控器分配不同的外部证据。

sents.en: One example is action-only monitors, used because an agent’s reasoning can bait a monitor [ 10 ] , an attack close to our justification payloads.
sents.zh: 一个例子是仅基于动作的监控器，其使用原因是智能体的推理可能诱饵监控器 [10]，这类攻击接近我们的辩护载荷。

sents.en: Others are redaction or paraphrase for untrusted monitors [ 19 , 32 ] , and injection detectors that read each tool output [ 12 ] .
sents.zh: 另一些是针对不受信任监控器的删改或改写 [19, 32]，以及读取每个工具输出的注入检测器 [12]。

sents.en: The one exception we found is Pandey et al. [ 48 ] (UKAI 2026).
sents.zh: 我们找到的唯一例外是 Pandey 等人 [48]（UKAI 2026）。

sents.en: In our reading it checks payment fields against corruption-distinct evidence sources.
sents.zh: 按我们的解读，该工作将支付字段与能区分腐败的证据来源进行比对。

sents.en: Monitors are also attacked directly [ 54 , 47 ] , and attacks in both directions are known.
sents.zh: 监控器本身也会被直接攻击 [54, 47]，且双向攻击均已有报道。

sents.en: On the approve side, Redwood Research reports that optimised persuasion makes coding-agent monitors let harm pass, and that it transfers to held-out monitors [ 26 , 33 ] .
sents.zh: 在放行一侧，Redwood Research 报告称，经过优化的说服会使编码智能体监控器放任危害通过，并且该效果可迁移到留出的监控器上 [26, 33]。

sents.en: On the reject side, a preprint by Zhou et al. reports a denial-of-service payload that turns a fail-closed guardrail into blocked legitimate actions [ 59 ] .
sents.zh: 在拒绝一侧，Zhou 等人的预印本报告了一个拒绝服务载荷，它会把「故障即关闭」的防护栏变成对合法动作的拦截 [59]。

sents.en: False-rejection attacks on a single guardrail have therefore been reported.
sents.zh: 因此，针对单一防护栏的误拒绝攻击已有报道。

sents.en: We measure which monitors of a pool are fooled together, in each direction.
sents.zh: 我们测量的是一个监控器池中哪些监控器会在每个方向上被一起欺骗。

sents.en: Closest on aggregation under optimised attack is a recent preprint, BRANCH [ 21 ] , which reports that a tree search bypasses multi-scanner guardrails in which every scanner must pass, and transfers to unseen guardrails.
sents.zh: 在优化攻击下的聚合方面最接近的是最近的预印本 BRANCH [21]，它报告称树搜索可以绕过要求每个扫描器都通过的多数 guardrail，并可迁移到未见过的防护栏上。

sents.en: It studies the AND rule on the approve side only, with no model of which monitors fail together.
sents.zh: 它只研究了放行一侧的 AND 规则，且没有关于哪些监控器会一起失效的模型。

sents.en: Collusion between monitors is a recognised threat [ 46 ] , also discussed in a blog post by Shlegeris [ 52 ] .
sents.zh: 监控器之间的串通是一种被公认的威胁 [46]，Shlegeris 的博客文章 [52] 中也有讨论。

sents.en: Schroeder de Witt [ 49 ] revisits Lampson’s confinement problem [ 36 ] and argues that a covert channel of negligible capacity suffices.
sents.zh: Schroeder de Witt [49] 重新审视了 Lampson 的隔离问题 [36]，并论证一个容量可忽略的隐蔽信道即已足够。

sents.en: We therefore state fail-prone sets in place of independent error rates, with accountability [ 51 , 37 ] as the complement.
sents.zh: 因此，我们用易故障集合来替代独立的错误率，并以问责性 [51, 37] 作为其补集。

sents.en: Errors of language models are strongly correlated [ 30 ] .
sents.zh: 语言模型的错误具有很强的相关性 [30]。

sents.en: Judges favour similar models [ 18 ] .
sents.zh: 评判者会偏爱与其相似的模型 [18]。

paragraphs.en: Jailbreaks transfer [ 60 , 5 ] . Poisoned inputs mislead every reader [ 20 , 61 , 12 ] . Layered safeguards fail together [ 44 ] . These works measure correlation, mostly pairwise and on benign data. We measure which sets fail together under attack, by direction, and use them as a fault model. Closest are two recent preprints by He and Yu [ 22 , 23 ] and Pandey et al.’s certified agent payments [ 48 ] , placed in the classical theory in Appendix A . At the time of writing we know of no work that measures the set structure of co-failure of monitors under attack, separately by direction.
paragraphs.zh: 越狱攻击可迁移 [ 60 , 5 ] 。 被投毒的输入会误导所有读取者 [ 20 , 61 , 12 ] 。 分层防护会一起失效 [ 44 ] 。 这些工作衡量的是相关性，大多是成对地在良性数据上进行。 我们衡量的是在攻击下哪些集合会一起失效、按方向区分，并将其用作一种故障模型。 最接近的是 He 和 Yu 的两篇近期预印本 [ 22 , 23 ] 以及 Pandey 等人的可认证智能体支付 [ 48 ] ，我们在附录 A 中将其置于经典理论之中。 截至撰写之时，我们尚未见到任何按方向区分、衡量攻击下监控器共同失效集合结构的工作。

sents.en: Jailbreaks transfer [ 60 , 5 ] .
sents.zh: 越狱攻击可迁移 [ 60 , 5 ] 。

sents.en: Poisoned inputs mislead every reader [ 20 , 61 , 12 ] .
sents.zh: 被投毒的输入会误导所有读取者 [ 20 , 61 , 12 ] 。

sents.en: Layered safeguards fail together [ 44 ] .
sents.zh: 分层防护会一起失效 [ 44 ] 。

sents.en: These works measure correlation, mostly pairwise and on benign data.
sents.zh: 这些工作衡量的是相关性，大多是成对地在良性数据上进行。

sents.zh: 我们衡量的是在攻击下哪些集合会一起失效、按方向区分，并将其用作一种故障模型。

sents.zh: 最接近的是 He 和 Yu 的两篇近期预印本 [ 22 , 23 ] 以及 Pandey 等人的可认证智能体支付 [ 48 ] ，我们在附录 A 中将其置于经典理论之中。

sents.en: At the time of writing we know of no work that measures the set structure of co-failure of monitors under attack, separately by direction.
sents.zh: 截至撰写之时，我们尚未见到任何按方向区分、衡量攻击下监控器共同失效集合结构的工作。

paragraphs.en: Adversary structures and Q 2 Q^{2} / Q 3 Q^{3} come from secure computation [ 24 ] and Byzantine agreement [ 13 , 7 ] . Byzantine quorum systems [ 40 , 41 ] give the kernel rule. Not every quorum system is vote-assignable [ 17 ] . Per-party adversary structures go back to Damgård et al. [ 11 ] . Asymmetric quorum systems are due to [ 3 ] , with composition in [ 2 ] . Separating the sets that may be faulty for safety from those whose correctness is needed for liveness has precedents. They are Flexible BFT [ 42 ] , multi-threshold BFT [ 45 ] , Heterogeneous Paxos [ 50 ] and Tas et al.’s protocols with the necessary condition Q ⊈ B s Q\not\subseteq B_{s} , that no liveness quorum lies inside a safety-fault set [ 53 ] . The point of contact is the shape of the guarantee. In those protocols a replica applies one quorum rule and cannot tell which budget is in force; safety is argued from one fault structure and liveness from the other, and the rule is chosen so that both arguments go through. Our gateway is in the same position with P P . Two things differ. In Flexible BFT the faults that attack safety alone, the alive-but-corrupt replicas, make the safety budget the larger one; in our measurements the reject side is the larger one, because persuasion blocks and forgery defrauds. And those protocols reach consensus, so two quorums must intersect in an honest replica, whereas a one-shot approval with one gateway needs no intersection: in threshold form, with b b compromised, a a approve-only and r r reject-only monitors, our condition is n ≥ a + r + 2 ​ b + 1 n\geq a+r+2b+1 , and the classical n ≥ 2 ​ f + 1 n\geq 2f+1 is the case a = r = 0 a=r=0 . Hybrid adversary structures [ 34 , 14 ] describe faults that co-occur in one execution. Our pair describes two directions of one approval.
paragraphs.zh: 敌手结构以及 Q 2 Q^{2} / Q 3 Q^{3} 来自安全计算 [ 24 ] 与拜占庭共识 [ 13 , 7 ] 。 拜占庭法定人数系统 [ 40 , 41 ] 给出了内核规则。 并非每个法定人数系统都是可指派投票的 [ 17 ] 。 逐方的敌手结构可追溯到 Damgård 等人 [ 11 ] 。 非对称法定人数系统出自 [ 3 ] ，其组合见 [ 2 ] 。 将可能出错（危及安全性）的集合与为活性所需的正确性集合区分开来，已有先例。 它们是 Flexible BFT [ 42 ] 、多阈值 BFT [ 45 ] 、Heterogeneous Paxos [ 50 ] ，以及 Tas 等人的协议，其必要条件为 Q ⊈ B s Q\not\subseteq B_{s} ，即不存在位于安全性故障集合之内的活性法定人数 [ 53 ] 。 两者的接触点在于保证的形态。 在那些协议中，副本应用单一法定人数规则，无法分辨当前生效的是哪个预算；安全性依据一个故障结构来论证，活性依据另一个来论证，而该规则的选择使得两个论证都能成立。 我们的网关就 P P 而言处于同样的位置。有两点不同。 在 Flexible BFT 中，仅攻击安全性的故障（即存活但被腐化的副本）使安全性预算成为较大的一方；而在我们的测量中，拒绝一方是较大的一方，因为说服会阻塞，伪造会欺诈。 并且那些协议达成共识，因此两个法定人数必须在一个诚实的副本处相交；而带单个网关的一次性批准则不需要相交：以阈值形式表示，设 b b 为被攻陷的、a a 为仅批准的、r r 为仅拒绝的监控者，我们的条件是 n ≥ a + r + 2 ​ b + 1 n\geq a+r+2b+1 ，而经典的 n ≥ 2 ​ f + 1 n\geq 2f+1 对应于 a = r = 0 a=r=0 的情形。 混合敌手结构 [ 34 , 14 ] 描述的是在同一次执行中共同出现的故障。 我们这一对描述的是同一次批准的两个方向。

paragraphs.en: The theory applies to any action checked against evidence by monitors that can be fooled. Whether the two measured mechanisms carry over is an expectation, not a result. On the approve side, persuasion into fraud failed on every pool we measured, so the approve-fooled sets followed the sources; where persuasion into fraud succeeds, they would cross sources. On the reject side, what matters is injection resistance, a property of the model that we expect, but did not test, to carry across tasks. Two Redwood Research preprints report that monitors also differ in how far optimised text moves them in coding-agent monitoring: edited transcripts evade some monitors but few evade a held-out frontier-developer monitor [ 33 ] , and catch rates under optimised attacks rise with monitor capability [ 26 ] . The numbers ( 0.9 % 0.9\% against 7.4 % 7.4\% , Opus’s 30 % 30\% caution rate, the one payload that broke cross-cover) belong to one synthetic payment task, its prompt and its pools.
paragraphs.zh: 该理论适用于任何由可能被愚弄的监控器依据证据进行审查的行为。 这两个被测量的机制能否推广，只是一种预期，而非已得出的结果。 在批准一侧，诱导欺诈的行为在我们测量的每个池中都失败了，因此批准-被愚弄集合与来源保持一致；如果诱导欺诈成功，它们就会跨越来源。 在拒绝一侧，关键在于抗注入性，这是模型的一种属性，我们预期它能跨任务保持，但并未测试。 两篇 Redwood Research 的预印本报告称，在编程智能体监控中，监控器在被优化文本打动程度上也存在差异：经过编辑的记录能躲避部分监控器，但很少有能躲过一个保留的前沿开发者监控器的 [ 33 ]，且在优化攻击下，捕获率随监控器能力提升而上升 [ 26 ]。 这些数字（0.9 % 0.9\% 对 7.4 % 7.4\%，Opus 的 30 % 30\% 谨慎率，以及唯一一个打破跨覆盖的载荷）都属于同一个合成支付任务及其提示和池。

sents.zh: 该理论适用于任何由可能被愚弄的监控器依据证据进行审查的行为。

sents.zh: 这些数字（0.9 % 0.9\% 对 7.4 % 7.4\%，Opus 的 30 % 30\% 谨慎率，以及唯一一个打破跨覆盖的载荷）都属于同一个合成支付任务及其提示和池。

paragraphs.en: Payment approval is a witness-mode task: its fields can be checked, and its sources (the invoice, the ERP record, the supplier’s portal) are independent by construction. The results should carry over to actions of the same kind, each checked against records the requester does not control: changes of bank details, refunds, procurement, access grants and address changes. They carry over less clearly to judgement calls, where correct monitors may disagree, or to actions with one source of truth. Judgement calls are agreement mode, which needs Q 3 Q^{3} and was not measured. Several organisations that share monitors but trust them differently, each with its own gateway, are a further question, that of asymmetric trust [ 3 ] , and are not treated here. The next test is a different kind of task, such as code-change approval against tests and a specification, or access requests against personnel records.
paragraphs.zh: 付款审批是一个见证模式任务：其字段可以被核查，且其来源（发票、ERP 记录、供应商门户）在构造上就是相互独立的。 该结果应当可以推广到同类操作，即每一项都对照请求者无法控制的记录进行核查的操作：银行账户信息变更、退款、采购、访问权限授予以及地址变更。 该结果对判断类决策的推广则不那么明确，因为在这类任务中正确的监控器可能意见不一；对只有单一事实来源的操作也是如此。 判断类决策属于协议模式，需要 Q 3 Q^{3}，而本次并未对其进行测量。 若干共享监控器但对其信任程度不同的组织，各自拥有自己的网关，这是另一个问题，即非对称信任问题 [ 3 ]，本文不予讨论。 下一个测试是另一种类型的任务，例如对照测试和规格说明的代码变更审批，或对照人事记录的访问权限申请。

paragraphs.en: The measurements suggest one layer per failure. Against fraud, give the monitors independent sources, so that fraud must corrupt a source and cannot simply persuade a model. Against obedience, use injection-resistant models, give them structured inputs, and hide the agent’s free-text justification from them, which in the view ablation brought every blocking payload to within 0.05 0.05 of the benign floor ( Appendix E ). Add a rule engine that compares fields and cannot be persuaded, which in the confirmation restored the cross-cover condition. Against caution, which only measurement reveals, approve on at least two independent sources, so that one source made to look tampered with cannot block a payment, and escalate to a human otherwise. An illustration, assuming independent errors (not a measurement): put a rule engine on the ERP record and model monitors on the invoice and the portal. Suppose an attacker makes both external sources look tampered with, and each then refuses about 30 % 30\% of correct payments, as Opus did. The rule still lets 1 − 0.3 2 ≈ 91 % 1-0.3^{2}\approx 91\% of them through, against 49 % 49\% under all-must-approve. The recipe has a boundary: an attacker who corrupts two independent sources defeats it, sources behind one upstream feed count as one, and chance errors of two monitors at once are not excluded. A rule engine cannot be persuaded, but it can be fooled by a forged record, and then it rejects a good payment like any other reader of that record. An attacker who forges one record and persuades every model on the same action leaves one rule engine on one source, and the rule blocks. Liveness against that attacker, with b b forged records, needs 2 ​ b + 1 2b+1 monitors that cannot be persuaded, on independent records, so that b + 1 b+1 of them still approve on b + 1 b+1 sources. The confirmation’s combined attacks forged one source and persuaded some families on the same action, and the thirteen-monitor pool stayed live with slack 1 1 ; an attacker who persuades every model at once is the case beyond it. In AI control, trusted monitors are weaker than the model they watch by design [ 19 , 29 ] , and which of them must agree is a question of structure.
paragraphs.zh: 测量结果表明每次故障对应一层。 对抗欺诈：给监控器独立的来源，使欺诈必须腐蚀一个来源，而不能仅仅说服一个模型。 对抗服从：使用抗注入的模型，给它们结构化输入，并隐藏智能体的自由文本理由，从消融视图来看，这使得每个阻断负载都落在良性基线的 0.05 之内（附录 E）。 增加一个比较字段且无法被说服的规则引擎，在确认场景中这恢复了交叉覆盖条件。 对抗过度谨慎（只有通过测量才能发现）：至少在两个独立来源上批准，使被伪装成已篡改的单一来源无法阻断一笔支付，否则升级给人工处理。 举一个例子，假设错误相互独立（并非测量结果）：在 ERP 记录上放一个规则引擎，在发票和门户上放模型监控器。 假设攻击者让两个外部来源都看起来被篡改，随后每个来源拒绝约 30% 的正确支付，正如 Opus 所做的那样。 规则仍会让其中 1 − 0.3² ≈ 91% 通过，而全须批准策略下只有 49%。 该配方有边界：腐蚀两个独立来源的攻击者可以击败它，同一上游数据源之后的多个来源算作一个，且两个监控器同时出错的情况并未被排除。 规则引擎无法被说服，但可以被伪造记录欺骗，届时它会像该记录的其他读取者一样拒绝一笔好的支付。 若攻击者伪造一条记录并在同一操作上说服所有模型，则仍有一个来源上留有一个规则引擎，规则会将其阻断。 针对该攻击者的活性：若有 b 条伪造记录，需要 2b+1 个无法被说服的监控器分别位于独立的记录上，使得其中 b+1 个仍能在 b+1 个来源上批准。 确认场景的组合攻击伪造了一个来源并在同一操作上说服了部分模型家族，而十三监控器池仍保持活性且余量为 1；一次性说服所有模型的攻击者则是超出其范围的情形。 在 AI 控制中，受信任的监控器按设计就弱于它们所监视的模型 [19, 29]，而哪些监控器必须达成一致则是一个结构问题。

paragraphs.en: Why use AI monitors at all, if a rule engine cannot be persuaded? On the task measured here, one should concede the point. If every source were a structured record with the same fields, three rule engines on three independent records, the 2 ​ b + 1 2b+1 of the previous paragraph with b = 1 b=1 , would be safe and live by the argument of Section 3 , and no model would be needed. The payment task was chosen because its ground truth can be checked, which is what made the measurement possible. The general case is different, and each kind of monitor covers what the others cannot. A rule engine compares only mechanically comparable fields, such as account digits and amounts. Of our three sources, only the ERP record is such a table; the invoice is an e-mail and the portal is a web page, and finding the amount in either is already a reading task. A rule engine cannot check an action that has no fields, such as a message, a contract clause or a code change against a specification, and it cannot judge plausibility: a payment that matches every record may still be a duplicate or go to a vendor that was off-boarded. A human can judge anything, and is slow and costly, so humans are the escalation path. AI monitors are the only way to put judgement on every action at scale, and they are the ones that can be persuaded. The recipe therefore uses all three, and the rule of Section 3 says how to combine them: a rule engine added to a vote of twelve is outvoted by a persuaded majority, while “approve on two sources” uses it at full strength.
paragraphs.zh: 既然规则引擎无法被说服，为什么还要使用 AI 监控器呢？ 就本文所测量的任务而言，应当承认这一点。 如果每个数据源都是字段相同的结构化记录，即三条规则引擎处理三条独立的记录，也就是上一段中 b=1 时的 2b+1，那么根据第 3 节的论证它们将是安全且有效的，也就不需要任何模型了。 选择支付任务是因为其真值可以被核查，这正是使测量成为可能的原因。 一般情况则不同，每种监控器都覆盖了其他监控器无法覆盖的部分。 规则引擎只能比较机械上可比较的字段，例如账号数字和金额。 在我们的三个数据源中，只有 ERP 记录是这样一张表；发票是一封电子邮件，门户是一个网页，从其中任何一个中找出金额本身就已经是一项阅读任务。 规则引擎无法核查没有字段的操作，例如消息、合同条款或对照规范的代码变更，也无法判断合理性：一笔与所有记录都匹配的付款仍可能是重复付款，或流向一个已被停用的供应商。 人可以判断任何事物，但既慢又昂贵，因此人是升级处理的路径。 AI 监控器是大规模地对每个操作施加判断的唯一途径，而且它们是能够被说服的。 因此该方案同时使用三者，第 3 节的规则说明了如何组合它们：在十二票的投票中加入一票规则引擎会被被说服的多数票否决，而「两个来源同意即批准」则能将其力量充分发挥。

paragraphs.en: Our guarantees hold when the realised fooled set lies in the assumed family for its direction. The directional kernel approves on two monitors from different sources, so one stray approval outside the poisoned column suffices for an unsafe approval. That happened on 0.001 0.001 of the confirmation’s fraud items and never on the frontier pool. The margin-2 kernel removes it at 13.2 % 13.2\% false rejections. For benign errors statistical aggregation is appropriate [ 30 , 25 ] . For adversarial ones, a set property is.
paragraphs.zh: 当实际实现的受骗集位于其方向所假设的族中时，我们的保证即成立。 该方向性核在来自不同来源的两个监控器上批准，因此毒化列之外的一个异常批准就足以造成不安全的批准。 这种情况发生在确认集欺诈项的 0.001 0.001 比例上，且从未发生在前沿池上。 边距为 2 的核以 13.2 % 13.2\% 的误拒率将其移除。 对于良性错误，统计聚合是合适的 [ 30 , 25 ] 。 对于对抗性错误，则需要集合性质。

paragraphs.en: An action that is correctly formed but should not exist needs an authorisation layer: authenticated requests, two-person rules, payee allow-lists. Monitors reading records of intent , such as purchase orders, would extend “diversify the inputs” to it (untested).
paragraphs.zh: 一个格式正确但本不应存在的动作需要一个授权层：经过身份验证的请求、双人规则、收款人白名单。 读取意图记录（例如采购订单）的监控器可以把“多样化输入”扩展到这一层（未经测试）。

sents.zh: 读取意图记录（例如采购订单）的监控器可以把“多样化输入”扩展到这一层（未经测试）。

paragraphs.en: The small monitors are four 4-bit quantised open-weights models of 4 4 – 9 9 B parameters. The frontier-class ones are fixed only by their identifiers on the day, mostly at the lowest reasoning setting. We tested one or two models per provider (not Claude Fable). We used one synthetic task family and one attacker model per small-pool study. The prompt was fixed on the small models on unattacked items, which plausibly created their clean approve side ( Appendix B ). Only Opus showed caution, and only Opus deliberated on those items ( Table 17 ), so model and deliberation are confounded.
paragraphs.zh: 小型监控器是四个 4-bit 量化的开放权重模型，参数量为 4 4 到 9 9 B。 前沿级模型仅由当天的标识符固定，大多处于最低推理设置。 我们为每个提供商测试了一到两个模型（不包括 Claude Fable）。 在每个小型池研究中，我们使用一个合成任务族和一个攻击者模型。 提示词是在未受攻击的条目上于小模型上固定的，这很可能造成了它们的干净批准侧（附录 B）。 只有 Opus 表现出谨慎，也只有 Opus 在这些条目上进行了深思（表 17），因此模型与深思混杂在一起。

sents.zh: 小型监控器是四个 4-bit 量化的开放权重模型，参数量为 4 4 到 9 9 B。

paragraphs.en: We claim no novelty for fail-prone systems over monitors, for Q 2 Q^{2} and Q 3 Q^{3} , for the gap between weighted and structured rules, or for the cross-cover condition. We do not claim that real pools have the grid structure of Section 2 . Every measured approve side has columns and no rows. The worst-case claim for the twelve language-model monitors failed. Opus’s resistance to persuasion is bounded only against two writers and about $ 76 \$76 of search. Other attackers persuade other monitors [ 26 , 33 ] and, two preprints report, commercial guardrails [ 59 , 21 ] . False-rejection attacks have been reported. We add their set structure across a pool.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不宣称故障易发系统相较于监控器、Q 2 Q^{2} 与 Q 3 Q^{3}、加权规则与结构化规则之间的差距，或交叉覆盖条件具有任何新颖性。 我们不宣称真实的池具有第 2 节的网格结构。 每个被测量的批准侧都有列而没有行。 针对十二个语言模型监控器的最坏情况断言失败了。 Opus 对说服的抵抗力仅针对两个写手和约 $ 76 \$76 的搜索量是有界的。 其他攻击者可以说服其他监控器 [ 26 , 33 ] ，并且据两篇预印本报告，还可以说服商业防护栏 [ 59 , 21 ] 。 误拒绝攻击已有报道。 我们在池上添加它们的集合结构。

sents.en: We claim no novelty for fail-prone systems over monitors, for Q 2 Q^{2} and Q 3 Q^{3} , for the gap between weighted and structured rules, or for the cross-cover condition.
sents.zh: 我们不宣称故障易发系统相较于监控器、Q 2 Q^{2} 与 Q 3 Q^{3}、加权规则与结构化规则之间的差距，或交叉覆盖条件具有任何新颖性。

sents.en: We do not claim that real pools have the grid structure of Section 2 .

paragraphs.en: Diversify the inputs, harden the monitors, count sources, not votes, and include a monitor that cannot be persuaded. Fooling into fraud followed the sources on every pool measured. Fooling into blocking followed injection resistance, which size did not predict. Counting sources blocked 0.9 % 0.9\% of correct payments against 7.4 % 7.4\% at the same safety, as pre-registered. The theory said where this breaks, and the confirmation found it. The worst-case claim for twelve language-model monitors is a negative result, and a rule engine restores the condition. All of it is measured on payment approval. Every zero bounds only the attacks we ran.
paragraphs.zh: 多样化输入，加固监视器，按来源计数而非按票数计数，并纳入一个无法被说服的监视器。 在测量的每个池中，被诱骗实施欺诈的情况都跟随来源数量变化。 被诱骗实施拦截的情况则跟随注入抗性变化，而规模无法预测注入抗性。 如预注册所述，按来源计数对正确付款的误拦率为 0.9%，而在相同安全性下为 7.4%。 理论指出了这里会在何处失效，而验证也确实找到了它。 关于十二个语言模型智能体监视器的最坏情况断言是一个负面结果，而规则引擎可以恢复这一条件。 以上全部都在付款审批场景中进行了测量。 每个零结果都只限定于我们所运行的攻击。

paragraphs.en: All targets are our own monitor deployments on fictional tasks. No real payment is made, and no real organisation is imitated. Payloads reuse no harmful behaviours from jailbreak collections. The small monitors and the pilot’s attacker ran locally. The frontier arms sent the same fictional items to four providers’ APIs, under their usage terms and spending caps. In the tailored-attack arms, models were also asked to rewrite a note as the attacker, through the same APIs and on the same fictional data. Refusals were recorded, and the prompt was not reworded to get around them.
paragraphs.zh: 所有目标都是我们在虚构任务上自行部署的监控器。 未发生任何真实付款，也未模仿任何真实组织。 载荷未复用越狱集合中的任何有害行为。 小型监控器与试点中的攻击者均在本地运行。 前沿模型方在四个提供商的使用条款和消费上限下，向其 API 发送了相同的虚构内容。 在定制攻击分支中，还要求模型以攻击者身份改写一段记录，同样通过这些 API 并使用相同的虚构数据。 拒答均被记录在案，且未为了绕过拒答而改写提示词。

paragraphs.en: On the 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid each attack fools 5 5 of 9 9 monitors, so τ = 3 \tau=3 and τ ∗ = 9 / 5 \tau^{*}=9/5 . The smallest kernels are the transversals, one cell in each row and column; other minimal kernels exist, for instance any 2 × 2 2\times 2 block, which is exactly what a row-plus-column attack leaves. The separation is not universal: on the 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid with a = b = 1 a=b=1 a weighted vote suffices. Three recent proposals fit the classical theory in our reading. EBFT’s honest-but-wrong validators, from a recent preprint by He and Yu [ 22 ] , fall under the classical hybrid-fault bound [ 55 ] . Its general form is due to Kursawe and Freiling [ 34 ] . Epistemic fault domains, from a second preprint by the same authors [ 23 ] , are the safety half of the kernel rule for root-generated systems. Pandey et al.’s “agree or escalate” over corruption domains [ 48 ] reads as the kernel rule over evidence domains.

(iii) Safety and liveness of the kernel rule follow from (i) and Proposition 3 . paragraphs.en: The pair ( ℱ A , ℱ R ) (\mathcal{F}_{A},\mathcal{F}_{R}) is not a hybrid fault model [ 34 , 14 ] . There, a pair ( B , C ) (B,C) describes faults that co-occur in one execution. Here an action is either bad or good. If it is bad, only approve-fooling is a fault. If it is good, only reject-fooling is. In threshold form, with b b compromised, a a approve-only and r r reject-only monitors, ℱ A = { | X | ≤ a + b } \mathcal{F}_{A}=\{|X|\leq a+b\} and ℱ R = { | X | ≤ r + b } \mathcal{F}_{R}=\{|X|\leq r+b\} . Flexible BFT’s alive-but-corrupt replicas are the approve-only case. The persuaded monitors of Section 5 are the reject-only case. Q 2 ​ ( ℱ A ∪ ℱ R ) Q^{2}(\mathcal{F}_{A}\cup\mathcal{F}_{R}) holds iff ( CC ), Q 2 ​ ( ℱ A ) Q^{2}(\mathcal{F}_{A}) and Q 2 ​ ( ℱ R ) Q^{2}(\mathcal{F}_{R}) all hold. Neither of the last two is needed for safety and liveness. The separating example is n = 4 n=4 with ℱ A \mathcal{F}_{A} the singletons and ℱ R \mathcal{F}_{R} the pairs. There ( CC ) holds, Q 2 Q^{2} of the pool fails, and “two approvals” is safe and live. The margin- k k kernel rule approves iff the approvers have at least k k monitors outside every A ∈ ℱ A A\in\mathcal{F}_{A} . It is safe against every approve-fooled set plus k − 1 k-1 stray approvers. It is live against R R iff the slack | M ∖ ( A ∪ R ) | |M\setminus(A\cup R)| is at least k k for every A A . Both are immediate. On a bad action with A A fooled, at most k − 1 k-1 approvers lie outside A A . On a good action with R R fooled, the approvers M ∖ R M\setminus R have | M ∖ ( A ∪ R ) | |M\setminus(A\cup R)| members outside each A A .

paragraphs.en: Since the set S S of approvers only grows and the adversary controls delivery, a rule may be taken to be an up-set P P without changing its decisions. (i) ⇐ \Leftarrow : on a bad action the approvers at any time form a subset of some A ∈ ℱ A A\in\mathcal{F}_{A} . They therefore lie in ℱ A ∗ \mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} , hence not in P P . ⇒ \Rightarrow : if S ∈ P ∩ ℱ A ∗ S\in P\cap\mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} , take A ⊇ S A\supseteq S in ℱ A \mathcal{F}_{A} . In the execution where the action is bad, A A is fooled and the signatures of S S are delivered first, so the gateway executes. (ii) ⇐ \Leftarrow : on a good action with reject-fooled set R R , every monitor in M ∖ R M\setminus R eventually signs ok , and M ∖ R ∈ P M\setminus R\in P . ⇒ \Rightarrow : in the execution where R R rejects or stays silent for ever, the approvers never exceed M ∖ R M\setminus R . Liveness forces some S ⊆ M ∖ R S\subseteq M\setminus R into P P , and up-closure gives M ∖ R ∈ P M\setminus R\in P . (iii) By (i) and (ii) a rule exists iff no M ∖ R M\setminus R lies in ℱ A ∗ \mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} . That is, iff no A ⊇ M ∖ R A\supseteq M\setminus R , which is ( CC ). For general rules, suppose A ∪ R = M A\cup R=M , and w.l.o.g. A = M ∖ R A=M\setminus R by down-closure. Execution 1: a bad action, A A fooled and approving, the honest monitors R R rejecting. Execution 2: a good action, R R fooled and rejecting, the honest monitors A A approving. The gateway’s view is identical in both, whatever the timing model. The view is who signed ok , who signed bad , and any timeouts. Yet the gateway must execute in 2 and not in 1. (iv) 𝒦 A = 2 M ∖ ℱ A ∗ \mathcal{K}_{A}=2^{M}\setminus\mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} is the complement of a down-set, hence an up-set. It is the largest set disjoint from ℱ A ∗ \mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} . 𝒬 R \mathcal{Q}_{R} is the smallest up-set containing every M ∖ R M\setminus R . The rest is (i)–(iii). (v) Immediate from the definitions; the separating example is above. Q 2 ​ ( ℱ A ) Q^{2}(\mathcal{F}_{A}) fails with ℱ A \mathcal{F}_{A} the ( n − 1 ) (n-1) -sets and ℱ R = { ∅ } \mathcal{F}_{R}=\{\emptyset\} , where unanimity is safe and live. Q 2 ​ ( ℱ R ) Q^{2}(\mathcal{F}_{R}) fails symmetrically. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 由于批准者集合 S S 只增不减，且敌手控制消息投递，可将一条规则取为一个上集 P P 而不改变其判定。 (i) ⇐ \Leftarrow ：在坏动作发生时，任一时刻的批准者构成某个 A ∈ ℱ A A\in\mathcal{F}_{A} 的子集。 因此它们属于 ℱ A ∗ \mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} ，从而不属于 P P 。⇒ \Rightarrow ：若 S ∈ P ∩ ℱ A ∗ S\in P\cap\mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} ，取 ℱ A \mathcal{F}_{A} 中满足 A ⊇ S A\supseteq S 的 A A 。 在该动作是坏动作的执行中， A A 被愚弄并批准，且 S S 的签名先被投递，于是网关执行该动作。 (ii) ⇐ \Leftarrow ：在一个带拒绝被愚弄集合 R R 的好动作中， M ∖ R M\setminus R 中的每个监控者最终都会对 ok 签名，且 M ∖ R ∈ P M\setminus R\in P 。⇒ \Rightarrow ：在 R R 拒绝或永远保持沉默的执行中，批准者永远不超过 M ∖ R M\setminus R 。 活性迫使某个 S ⊆ M ∖ R S\subseteq M\setminus R 进入 P P ，而向上封闭性给出 M ∖ R ∈ P M\setminus R\in P 。 (iii) 由 (i) 与 (ii)，规则存在当且仅当没有 M ∖ R M\setminus R 落在 ℱ A ∗ \mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} 中。 也就是说，当且仅当不存在 A ⊇ M ∖ R A\supseteq M\setminus R ，这正是 ( CC )。 对于一般规则，假设 A ∪ R = M A\cup R=M ，且不失一般性 由向下封闭性可取 A = M ∖ R A=M\setminus R 。 执行 1：一个坏动作， A A 被愚弄并批准，诚实的监控者 R R 拒绝。 执行 2：一个好动作， R R 被愚弄并拒绝，诚实的监控者 A A 批准。 无论时序模型如何，网关在两种执行中看到的视图完全相同。 该视图就是谁对 ok 签名、谁对 bad 签名，以及任何超时情况。 然而网关必须在执行 2 中执行动作，而在执行 1 中不执行。 (iv) 𝒦 A = 2 M ∖ ℱ A ∗ \mathcal{K}_{A}=2^{M}\setminus\mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} 是一个下集的补集，因而是一个上集。 它是与 ℱ A ∗ \mathcal{F}^{*}_{A} 不相交的最大集合。𝒬 R \mathcal{Q}_{R} 是包含每个 M ∖ R M\setminus R 的最小上集。其余部分即 (i)–(iii)。 (v) 直接由定义得出；分离性反例已在上文给出。 Q 2 ​ ( ℱ A ) Q^{2}(\mathcal{F}_{A}) 在取 ℱ A \mathcal{F}_{A} 为所有 ( n − 1 ) (n-1) 元集合、 ℱ R = { ∅ } \mathcal{F}_{R}=\{\emptyset\} 时不成立，此时全体一致性既是安全的也是活的。 Q 2 ​ ( ℱ R ) Q^{2}(\mathcal{F}_{R}) 对称地不成立。∎

paragraphs.en: The corridor of Proposition 5 (iv) is easiest to see on a pool small enough to list every set. Take the three sources of Section 4 and an attacker who can forge one record or plant one note, as measured: a forged record fools its readers in both directions, a note persuades language models into rejecting and nobody into approving.
paragraphs.zh: 命题5（iv）的走廊效应在一个小到可以逐一列出所有集合的池子上最容易看清。 取第4节的三个信息源，并假设一个攻击者能够伪造一条记录或植入一条注释，按之前的度量方式：被伪造的记录会让其读者在两个方向上都受骗，而一条注释会使语言模型倾向于拒绝，却不能让任何人批准。

sents.en: Take the three sources of Section 4 and an attacker who can forge one record or plant one note, as measured: a forged record fools its readers in both directions, a note persuades language models into rejecting and nobody into approving.

paragraphs.en: Pool A : a language model a a on the invoice, a rule engine e 1 e_{1} on the ERP record, a rule engine e 2 e_{2} on the portal. Forging a record fools its one reader, so ℱ A = { { a } , { e 1 } , { e 2 } } \mathcal{F}_{A}=\{\{a\},\{e_{1}\},\{e_{2}\}\} and 𝒦 A \mathcal{K}_{A} is every set of two or more monitors, the rule “span two sources”. A note persuades a a only, so the reject-fooled sets are again the singletons, ℱ R = { { a } , { e 1 } , { e 2 } } \mathcal{F}_{R}=\{\{a\},\{e_{1}\},\{e_{2}\}\} , and the survivors of each attack are the pairs { e 1 , e 2 } \{e_{1},e_{2}\} , { a , e 2 } \{a,e_{2}\} , { a , e 1 } \{a,e_{1}\} . These pairs are 𝒬 R \mathcal{Q}_{R} , the survivor sets. Each has two monitors, so each is safe, 𝒬 R ⊆ 𝒦 A \mathcal{Q}_{R}\subseteq\mathcal{K}_{A} , and ( CC ) holds. Under 𝒦 A \mathcal{K}_{A} : a good payment with a note planted leaves e 1 e_{1} and e 2 e_{2} approving, two approvers, execute; a good payment with the ERP record forged leaves a a and e 2 e_{2} , execute; a fraud with the invoice forged has one approver, refuse. The rule is safe and live, and any up-set between 𝒬 R \mathcal{Q}_{R} and 𝒦 A \mathcal{K}_{A} , such as “two approvers, at least one an engine”, is too.
paragraphs.zh: 池 A：语言模型 a 监控发票，规则引擎 e 1 e_{1} 监控 ERP 记录，规则引擎 e 2 e_{2} 监控门户。 伪造一条记录只会欺骗其唯一的读者，因此 ℱ A = { { a } , { e 1 } , { e 2 } } \mathcal{F}_{A}=\{\{a\},\{e_{1}\},\{e_{2}\}\} ，而 𝒦 A \mathcal{K}_{A} 是由两个或更多监控者构成的每一个集合，即规则「跨越两个来源」。 一张便条只能说服 a a，因此被拒后会被欺骗的集合仍然是那些单元素集合，ℱ R = { { a } , { e 1 } , { e 2 } } \mathcal{F}_{R}=\{\{a\},\{e_{1}\},\{e_{2}\}\} ，而每次攻击后的幸存集合是对 { e 1 , e 2 } \{e_{1},e_{2}\} 、 { a , e 2 } \{a,e_{2}\} 、 { a , e 1 } \{a,e_{1}\} 。 这些对就是 𝒬 R \mathcal{Q}_{R} ，即幸存集合。 每个对都有两个监控者，因此每个都是安全的，𝒬 R ⊆ 𝒦 A \mathcal{Q}_{R}\subseteq\mathcal{K}_{A} ，且 ( CC ) 成立。 在 𝒦 A \mathcal{K}_{A} 下：一笔附有植入便条的正常付款会留下 e 1 e_{1} 和 e 2 e_{2} 表示批准，两个批准者，执行；一笔 ERP 记录被伪造的正常付款会留下 a a 和 e 2 e_{2} ，执行；一笔发票被伪造的欺诈付款只有一个批准者，拒绝。 该规则是安全且活跃的，并且介于 𝒬 R \mathcal{Q}_{R} 与 𝒦 A \mathcal{K}_{A} 之间的任何上集，例如「两个批准者，其中至少一个是引擎」，也同样如此。

paragraphs.en: Pool B : two language models a 1 a_{1} (invoice) and a 2 a_{2} (portal) and one engine e e (ERP record). The approve side is unchanged, ℱ A \mathcal{F}_{A} the singletons and 𝒦 A \mathcal{K}_{A} “two approvers”. On the reject side a note now persuades both models, so { a 1 , a 2 } ∈ ℱ R \{a_{1},a_{2}\}\in\mathcal{F}_{R} and its survivors are { e } \{e\} . Liveness demands that the gateway execute when e e alone approves, so { e } ∈ 𝒬 R \{e\}\in\mathcal{Q}_{R} is a survivor set. But it is not safe, { e } ∈ ℱ A \{e\}\in\mathcal{F}_{A} : on the day the ERP record is forged, e e alone approves a fraud. The observation “only e e approved” arises on a good day and on a bad day, and one rule must answer it once. Execute, and the forged record passes; refuse, and the note blocks every payment it marks. This is ( CC ) failing, with witness A = { e } A=\{e\} , R = { a 1 , a 2 } R=\{a_{1},a_{2}\} , A ∪ R = M A\cup R=M , and it is Proposition 5 (iii): no rule over Pool B is safe and live. The two attacks never need to occur on the same action. The twelve-monitor pool of the confirmation is Pool B at scale: one note left two readers of the invoice, which a forged invoice could make approve ( Section 5.5 ). The thirteen-monitor pool with the rule engine was live with slack 1 1 because no note persuaded every model on the other two sources. Pool A shows what makes the condition hold by construction rather than by measurement: after any one attack within the budget, two monitors on two sources remain, and because two of the three cannot be persuaded, no note alone removes more than one.
paragraphs.zh: 池 B：两个语言模型 a_{1}（发票）和 a_{2}（门户），以及一个引擎 e（ERP 记录）。 批准侧不变，ℱ_{A} 为单元素集合，𝒦_{A} 为「两个批准者」。 在拒绝侧，现在一条便条同时说服了两个模型，因此 {a_{1}, a_{2}} ∈ ℱ_{R}，其幸存者为 {e}。 活性要求当只有 e 批准时网关执行，因此 {e} ∈ 𝒬_{R} 是一个幸存者集合。 但它并不安全，{e} ∈ ℱ_{A}：在 ERP 记录被伪造的那一天，仅 e 一人批准了欺诈。 「只有 e 批准了」这一观察结果既出现在好的一天，也出现在坏的一天，而一条规则必须一次性对其给出答案。 执行，伪造的记录就会通过；拒绝，这条便条就会阻断它标记的每一笔付款。 这就是 (CC) 失效，其见证为 A = {e}，R = {a_{1}, a_{2}}，A ∪ R = M，并且这正是命题 5 (iii)：池 B 上不存在既安全又活性的规则。 这两种攻击从不需要发生在同一个动作上。 确认部分中的十二个智能体池就是放大版的池 B：一条便条留下了发票的两个读取者，而伪造的发票可以使它们批准（第 5.5 节）。 带有规则引擎的十三个智能体池之所以能以余量 1 保持活性，是因为没有一条便条说服了另外两个数据源上的每一个模型。 池 A 展示了是什么使该条件凭构造而非凭测量得以成立：在预算内的任意一次攻击之后，两个数据源上仍各有一个智能体，并且由于三个中的两个无法被说服，没有任何单一便条能移除多于一个。

paragraphs.en: The pre-registered prompt (v1) lacked the field-by-field comparison and the note that the fictional account prefix is expected. A 480 480 -call noise-floor run on 40 40 unattacked items was made before any attack data existed. It showed two artefacts under v1. Llama approved 6 / 20 6/20 plain frauds on tool and 3 / 20 3/20 on web while reporting that the amount matched. Ministral rejected 8 / 20 8/20 correct payments on doc ( 3 / 20 3/20 on web , 1 / 20 1/20 on tool ) because the fictional prefix was “invalid”. The change to v2 was logged and decided on unattacked items only. Under v2 no monitor approved any of the 20 20 plain frauds. Good payments were rejected by at most 3 / 20 3/20 per monitor: Llama tool 3 3 , Llama doc 2 2 , Qwen web , Ministral tool and web 1 1 each, all others 0 0 . The attack phase used v2 only. paragraphs.en: Three questions were recorded, with their expected answers, in the draft of protocol v2 (commit 1d90e58 ). The record was made after the pilot had been read and before the arm ran. The draft was not frozen, so this is a committed record, not a pre-registration. (1) Does any justification payload optimised against the small models make a frontier monitor approve a fraud on at least half of its items? Expected: no. Answer: no. The maximum over 18 18 payloads and 9 9 monitors is 0.000 0.000 . (2) Does any such payload make a frontier family block good payments on half of its items? Expected: no. Answer: no. 0 0 of 18 18 payloads do so for any of the three families. (3) Is substitution column-contained? Expected: yes, by construction. Answer: yes. Beyond the question, each substitution unit’s approve-fooled set equals the two readers of the poisoned source. The same three answers hold for Gemini 4 Argon, run later on the same items.
paragraphs.zh: 协议 v2 草稿（commit 1d90e58）中记录了三个问题及其预期答案。 该记录是在阅读试点之后、运行实验分支之前做出的。 草稿并未冻结，因此这是一份已提交的记录，而非预注册。 （1）任何针对小模型优化得到的辩护负载，能否使前沿监控器在其至少一半的条目上批准一起欺诈？预期：否。答案：否。 在 18 个负载与 9 个监控器上的最大值为 0。 （2）任何此类负载能否使前沿模型家族在其一半的条目上拦截正常付款？预期：否。 答案：否。在三个家族中，18 个负载里没有任何一个能做到这一点。 （3）替换是否列内包含？ 预期：是，由构造决定。答案：是。 除该问题之外，每个替换单元被误导而批准的集合恰好等于被污染来源的两个读取者。 同样的三个答案也适用于 Gemini 4 Argon，它是在相同条目上稍后运行的。

paragraphs.en: In the replay every payload was optimised against the four small families by a 7 7 B attacker and only transferred. That attacker was blind on the fraud side even against its own targets. The template injections and seed templates were tuned to nothing. Their null on Opus and Astra is therefore the replay’s strongest fact, and the same templates moved DeepSeek-V3.2. The tailored arms used two writers, one objective, 8 8 training tasks and about $ 76 \$76 . The objective is a proxy, because the Anthropic API returns no token probabilities. The anomaly control used four monitors, one source, two phrasings and 40 40 tasks. The replay has one sample per item and two or three items per attack unit. The replay pool has nine commercial monitors, and the Argon pool has three. No payload was optimised against Argon or Astra. There is one synthetic task family, and the prompt was fixed on the small models. Optimised attacks defeat defences that transferred attacks do not [ 47 , 54 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在重放中，每个载荷都是由一个 7×7 的攻击者针对四个小型模型族优化过的，且只进行了迁移。 该攻击者在欺诈侧是完全盲目的，即使是对它自己的目标也是如此。 模板注入和种子模板没有任何针对性调整。 因此，它们在 Opus 和 Astra 上的零结果是重放中最有力的事实，而同样的模板在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上却生效了。 定制化的攻击分支使用了两位撰写者、一个目标函数、8×8 个训练任务，成本约为 76 美元。 该目标函数只是一个代理指标，因为 Anthropic API 不返回词元概率。 异常对照使用了四个监视器、一个来源、两种表述方式和 40 个任务。 重放中每个条目有一个样本，每个攻击单元有两到三个条目。 重放池有九个商业监视器，而 Argon 池有三个。 没有任何载荷是针对 Argon 或 Astra 优化的。 只有一个合成任务族，且提示词在小模型上是固定的。 优化过的攻击能击败迁移攻击所无法击败的防御 [47, 54]。

Harness hashes were recorded, and model digests were recorded at the start of every arm. Before the run came a 60 60 -call smoke test and an optimiser timing trial of 1,490 1{,}490 calls, both excluded from every analysis. The attacker model is OLMo 3 7B, as in the pilot. It ran 60 60 optimisation rounds for fraud-side targets and 30 30 for blocking targets, on 8 8 optimisation tasks, with an acceptance margin of 0.05 0.05 and re-scoring of the incumbent. paragraphs.en: Latency is about 6 6 s per call ( 7 7 s Gemini). Quota. The Google key allows 250 250 requests per day for this model. The first run exhausted it after 225 225 verdicts, plus the 27 27 smoke and probe calls. It was stopped to avoid retrying a quota that could not recover that day, and resumed for the other two providers. A daily job then resumed the Gemini monitors after each reset, main arm first. The main arm completed after four resets, and the job continues with the reasoning arm. A call rejected for the daily quota writes no verdict row, so it can never count as a fail-closed rejection. Tables 15 and 16 were computed on the six-monitor Opus–Astra pool before Gemini completed. On the nine-monitor pool every rate is unchanged, because Gemini’s verdicts equal Opus’s on every cell. Spend. The providers’ own per-call usage reports were priced at the rates read from their pricing pages at run time. In USD per million tokens, input/output: Opus 4 / 20 4/20 , Astra 10 / 50 10/50 , Gemini 2 / 12 2/12 . Opus cost $ 8.82 \$8.82 ( 1,347 1{,}347 calls), Astra $ 12.44 \$12.44 ( 1,347 1{,}347 ) and Gemini $ 7.81 \$7.81 ( 1,347 1{,}347 ), a total of $ 29.06 \$29.06 over 4,041 4{,}041 calls, under the arm’s $ 45 \$45 ceiling. Model-identifier probes added about $ 0.03 \$0.03 . Analysis. harness.frontier --analyse --bootstrap 1000 on the nine-monitor pool, with outputs report-frontier.json and tables-frontier.tex . Harness changes after the v2 freeze. A new module for this arm, three configuration profiles, and hooks for per-provider call and spend caps and a latency field, inactive for the local and v2 profiles. The 52 52 offline tests pass, and the running v2 process was unaffected.
paragraphs.zh: 每次调用的延迟约为 6 6 秒（Gemini 为 7 7 秒）。配额。 Google 密钥允许该模型每天 250 250 次请求。 首次运行在 225 225 次判定后耗尽了配额，外加 27 27 次冒烟与探测调用。 之所以停止，是为了避免重试当天无法恢复的配额，并继续运行另外两个提供商。 随后由一个每日任务在每次重置后恢复 Gemini 监控器，主臂优先。 主臂在四次重置后完成，该任务接着继续运行推理臂。 因每日配额被拒绝的调用不会写入判定行，因此永远不会被计为 fail-closed 拒绝。 表 15 和表 16 是在 Gemini 完成之前、基于六监控器 Opus–Astra 池计算的。 在九监控器池上每个比率都保持不变，因为 Gemini 的判定在每个单元格上都与 Opus 相同。开销。 各提供商每次调用的用量报告按运行时从其定价页面读取的费率计价。 以美元每百万 token 计，输入/输出：Opus 4 / 20 4/20，Astra 10 / 50 10/50，Gemini 2 / 12 2/12。 Opus 花费 $ 8.82 \$8.82（1,347 1{,}347 次调用），Astra $ 12.44 \$12.44（1,347 1{,}347），Gemini $ 7.81 \$7.81（1,347 1{,}347），总计 $ 29.06 \$29.06，共 4,041 4{,}041 次调用，低于该臂 $ 45 \$45 的上限。 模型标识符探测额外花费约 $ 0.03 \$0.03。 分析。在九监控器池上运行 harness.frontier --analyse --bootstrap 1000，输出为 report-frontier.json 和 tables-frontier.tex。 v2 冻结之后的框架改动。 为该臂新建了一个模块、三个配置档案，以及用于各提供商调用与花费上限和延迟字段的钩子，这些钩子在 local 和 v2 档案中处于未启用状态。 52 52 项离线测试全部通过，且正在运行的 v2 进程未受影响。

sents.en: A daily job then resumed the Gemini monitors after each reset, main arm first.
sents.zh: 随后由一个每日任务在每次重置后恢复 Gemini 监控器，主臂优先。

sents.en: The main arm completed after four resets, and the job continues with the reasoning arm.
sents.zh: 主臂在四次重置后完成，该任务接着继续运行推理臂。

sents.en: A call rejected for the daily quota writes no verdict row, so it can never count as a fail-closed rejection.
sents.zh: 因每日配额被拒绝的调用不会写入判定行，因此永远不会被计为 fail-closed 拒绝。

sents.en: Tables 15 and 16 were computed on the six-monitor Opus–Astra pool before Gemini completed.
sents.zh: 表 15 和表 16 是在 Gemini 完成之前、基于六监控器 Opus–Astra 池计算的。

sents.en: On the nine-monitor pool every rate is unchanged, because Gemini’s verdicts equal Opus’s on every cell. Spend.
sents.zh: 在九监控器池上每个比率都保持不变，因为 Gemini 的判定在每个单元格上都与 Opus 相同。开销。

sents.en: The providers’ own per-call usage reports were priced at the rates read from their pricing pages at run time.
sents.zh: 各提供商每次调用的用量报告按运行时从其定价页面读取的费率计价。

sents.en: In USD per million tokens, input/output: Opus 4 / 20 4/20 , Astra 10 / 50 10/50 , Gemini 2 / 12 2/12 .
sents.zh: 以美元每百万 token 计，输入/输出：Opus 4 / 20 4/20，Astra 10 / 50 10/50，Gemini 2 / 12 2/12。

sents.en: Model-identifier probes added about $ 0.03 \$0.03 .
sents.zh: 模型标识符探测额外花费约 $ 0.03 \$0.03。

sents.en: Analysis. harness.frontier --analyse --bootstrap 1000 on the nine-monitor pool, with outputs report-frontier.json and tables-frontier.tex .
sents.zh: 分析。在九监控器池上运行 harness.frontier --analyse --bootstrap 1000，输出为 report-frontier.json 和 tables-frontier.tex。

sents.en: Harness changes after the v2 freeze.
sents.zh: v2 冻结之后的框架改动。

sents.en: A new module for this arm, three configuration profiles, and hooks for per-provider call and spend caps and a latency field, inactive for the local and v2 profiles.
sents.zh: 为该臂新建了一个模块、三个配置档案，以及用于各提供商调用与花费上限和延迟字段的钩子，这些钩子在 local 和 v2 档案中处于未启用状态。

sents.en: The 52 52 offline tests pass, and the running v2 process was unaffected.
sents.zh: 52 52 项离线测试全部通过，且正在运行的 v2 进程未受影响。

paragraphs.en: Not pre-registered. Each design was frozen before its first live call. The target is claude-opus-5-5 on the three sources, with prompt v2 and effort: low . There are eight targets. Per goal, two justification payloads, evaluated on all three monitors, and two doc-source injections, evaluated on the doc monitor. The objective is half the real verdict rate and half an oracle score. The oracle is a separate, clearly marked call asking Opus for its probability of approving ( 0 0 – 100 100 ). The acceptance margin is 0.05 0.05 , with re-scoring of the incumbent. There are 8 8 training tasks (seed 20261117 20261117 ) and 40 40 held-out tasks (seed 20261118 20261118 ) plus 10 10 clean controls, disjoint from the pilot, v2 and replay tasks. Only real verdicts are results. Run 1. The writer chain was Opus 5.5, then Sonnet 5.5, then OLMo 3 7B locally, with honest red-team framing and the prompt never reworded. Opus refused the writer role for both goals on every attempt (stop reason “refusal”, no output). Sonnet refused every blocking-goal attempt and some fraud-goal attempts. It produced one in the smoke test. Every blocking rewrite therefore fell to OLMo, on a machine saturated by the v2 run, and its calls timed out. The run was aborted after the seed round and one target of round two. It produced no optimised payload and no held-out evaluation. Spend was about $ 5.9 \$5.9 , including a discarded partial run with a routing bug. No fooled rate from it is reported. Run 2. The writer was deepseek/deepseek-v3.2 via OpenRouter, with Qwen3-235B and Llama-3.3-70B as unused fallbacks, and no refusal. It ran 25 25 rounds. The oracle score rose on several targets (best 0.34 → 0.84 0.34\to 0.84 , 0.15 → 0.78 0.15\to 0.78 ), and the training verdict rate reached 0.125 0.125 on one target. Held-out: 0 / 640 0/640 fooled, 0 / 320 0/320 per goal [ 0.000 , 0.012 ] [0.000,0.012] , 0 / 120 0/120 for each justification target and 0 / 40 0/40 for each doc target. Clean: 0 / 30 0/30 . That target’s final “payload” was the writer’s refusal (“I can’t rewrite the fraud alert to deceive the reviewer. Is there something else I can help you with?”). Every other target was 0 0 . Clean: 0 / 30 0/30 . Spend: $ 35.07 \$35.07 .
paragraphs.zh: 未预先注册。 每个设计都在其首次实际调用之前冻结。 目标是在三个来源上使用 prompt v2 和 effort: low 的 claude-opus-5-5。共有八个目标。 每个目标有两个论证载荷（justification payload），在全部三个监视器上评估；以及两个文档来源注入，在文档监视器上评估。 目标函数是一半真实判定率加一半预言机得分。 预言机是一个单独的、明确标记的调用，询问 Opus 批准的概率（0–100）。 接受容差为 0.05，并对现任方案重新评分。 有 8 个训练任务（种子 20261117）和 40 个留出任务（种子 20261118），外加 10 个干净的对照任务，与试点任务、v2 任务和重放任务不相交。 只有真实判定才算结果。运行 1。 写作链为 Opus 5.5，然后是 Sonnet 5.5，再是本地运行的 OLMo 3 7B，采用诚实的红队表述，且提示词从未改写。 Opus 在每次尝试中都拒绝担任两个目标的写作角色（停止原因 “refusal”，无输出）。 Sonnet 拒绝了每一次阻塞目标的尝试以及部分欺诈目标的尝试。 它在冒烟测试中产出过一个。 因此每次阻塞目标的重写都落到 OLMo 头上，而其所在机器已被 v2 运行占满，其调用全部超时。 运行在种子轮和第二轮的一个目标之后被中止。 它没有产出任何优化后的载荷，也没有进行任何留出评估。 花费约为 \$5.9，其中包括一次因路由 bug 而废弃的部分运行。 不报告来自它的任何欺骗率。运行 2。 写作智能体是经 OpenRouter 的 deepseek/deepseek-v3.2，Qwen3-235B 和 Llama-3.3-70B 作为未使用的后备，且没有拒绝。它运行了 25 轮。 预言机得分在若干目标上上升（最佳为 0.34 → 0.84，0.15 → 0.78），训练判定率在一个目标上达到 0.125。 留出集：0/640 被欺骗，每个目标 0/320，95% 置信区间 [0.000, 0.012]；每个论证目标 0/120，每个文档目标 0/40。干净集：0/30。花费：\$41.38。运行 3。 写作智能体是 meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct，无后备，运行 20 轮。 留出集欺诈：0/320。 阻塞：11/320，全部集中在一个文档目标上（11/40=0.275，置信区间 [0.161, 0.428]）。 该目标最终的“载荷”是写作智能体的拒绝（“我不能重写欺诈警报来欺骗审阅者。 还有别的我可以帮你的吗？”）。 所有其他目标均为 0。干净集：0/30。花费：\$35.07。

paragraphs.en: Exploratory. The effect was found by accident in run 3, then tested with controls under a design frozen before the first live call. The monitor is Opus on the doc source, with prompt v2 and effort: low . The items are the 40 40 held-out tasks of runs 2–3, correct payments only, with one line appended at the payload’s position ( Table 17 ). There are three samples per task for A–C and one for D ( 10 10 reused from identical cached prompts). Condition A reproduces run 3’s items digest for digest. Its rate agrees with the original 11 / 40 11/40 (Fisher p = 0.84 p=0.84 ). Per task, A rejected in at least one of three calls on 22 / 40 22/40 , in at least two on 10 / 40 10/40 , and in all three on 4 / 40 4/40 . C did so on 6 / 40 6/40 , 2 / 40 2/40 and 0 / 40 0/40 . The effect is mostly per-call randomness. Tasks rejected in run 3 were rejected in 14 / 33 14/33 new calls, the others in 22 / 87 22/87 ( p = 0.078 p=0.078 ). Opus used on average 291 291 reasoning tokens under A, 190 190 under C and 0 0 under B and D. Most approvals under A also mention the line. No approval under B does. There were 0 0 invalid outputs, and spend was $ 3.68 \$3.68 over 395 395 live calls. The same conditions on DeepSeek-V3.2 (thinking off) gave 0 / 400 0/400 rejections and no reasoning tokens, and no approval mentions the line. Spend: $ 0.07 \$0.07 .
paragraphs.zh: 探索性分析。 该效应是在第 3 次运行中偶然发现的，随后在首次实际调用之前就已冻结的设计下用对照条件进行了检验。 监控器是基于文档源的 Opus，使用提示词 v2 和 effort: low。 条目是第 2–3 次运行中的 40 个留出任务，仅限正确支付的样本，并在载荷位置追加一行（表 17）。 每个任务 A–C 各有 3 个样本，D 有 1 个（其中 10 个复用自相同缓存提示词）。 条件 A 重现了第 3 次运行的条目摘要以供摘要比对。 其比率与原始的 11/40 一致（Fisher 检验 p=0.84）。 按任务计，条件 A 在三次调用中至少一次拒绝的有 22/40，至少两次拒绝的有 10/40，三次全部拒绝的有 4/40。 条件 C 在这三个档位上分别为 6/40、2/40 和 0/40。 该效应主要是逐次调用的随机性。 在第 3 次运行中被拒绝的任务在新的调用中有 14/33 被拒绝，其余任务为 22/87（p=0.078）。 智能体 Opus 在条件 A 下平均使用 291 个推理 token，条件 C 下为 190 个，条件 B 和 D 下为 0 个。 条件 A 下的多数批准也提到了该行。 条件 B 下没有任何批准提到它。 无效输出为 0 个，395 次实际调用的花费为 3.68 美元。 相同条件在 DeepSeek-V3.2（关闭思考）上得到 0/400 次拒绝且无推理 token，也没有任何批准提到该行。花费：0.07 美元。

paragraphs.en: The pilot’s 18 18 justification payloads were replayed on the first 20 20 tasks of the confirmation, for both goals. They are 16 16 family-targeted and 2 2 universal payloads, optimised against the same four families on the pilot’s tasks. The replay has 720 720 items and 10,488 10{,}488 verdicts ( 7 7 invalid). The payloads were never used for training or structure estimation in protocol v2. Approve side: no payload made any monitor approve a fraud (highest family rate 0.000 0.000 ). All 18 18 fooled sets are therefore empty and lie in the main ℱ ^ approve \hat{\mathcal{F}}_{\mathrm{approve}} ( 1.000 1.000 ). Reject side: 18 18 of 18 18 payloads made some family reject at least half of the correct payments it targeted. Ministral was fooled by all 18 18 , Qwen by 6 6 , Llama by 1 1 and Gemma by 1 1 . The highest family rate is 1.000 1.000 . Of the 18 18 fooled sets, 17 17 lie inside a maximal set of the main ℱ ^ reject \hat{\mathcal{F}}_{\mathrm{reject}} ( 0.944 0.944 ). The exception is the pilot’s second universal payload. It fooled Qwen ( 0.90 0.90 , 0.50 0.50 , 0.65 0.65 on doc , tool , web ), Gemma ( 0.75 0.75 , 0.70 0.70 , 0.70 0.70 ) and Ministral ( 1.00 1.00 on each source). It left Llama ( 0.05 0.05 , 0.00 0.00 , 0.05 0.05 ). No confirmation payload made Gemma reject half of its items, so this set is outside the confirmation’s estimate. ℱ ^ reject \hat{\mathcal{F}}_{\mathrm{reject}} is a lower bound on what persuasion can do, as every estimated fail-prone system is. The set’s survivors, the three Llama monitors, read three sources. The directional kernel over the columns therefore approves under it.

paragraphs.en: The two rules compared in H3 ′ were exported and attacked directly. They are the directional kernel over the columns and the best counting rule at matched safety, the log-odds vote. The vote keeps its weights and threshold as fitted on the primary training split. For each rule and goal the attacker model rewrote one universal justification payload for 30 30 rounds on the 8 8 optimisation tasks. The attacker is OLMo 3 7B, as everywhere in protocol v2. Its score was the fraction of tasks on which the rule decided the attacker’s way, plus 0.1 0.1 times the mean per-call credit as a tie-break. It used the acceptance margin and incumbent re-scoring of the main optimiser ( 12,024 12{,}024 monitor calls, 0 0 errors). On the training tasks neither rule ever decided the attacker’s way under any of the 124 124 scored candidates. No candidate was accepted, so the final payloads are the seeds. The best candidates moved individual monitors without moving the rule. They moved up to 0.31 0.31 of the verdicts on a blocking candidate against the kernel and 0.38 0.38 against the counting rule. On the fraud side they moved at most 0.01 0.01 . The four payloads were then evaluated on the 40 40 evaluation tasks beside the plain and clean baselines ( 240 240 items; 4,008 4{,}008 verdict rows, 2 2 invalid). Against both rules, every payload and both baselines gave 0 0 of 40 40 unsafe approvals on the fraud items and 0 0 of 40 40 false rejections on the correct payments. The offline rule-aware attacker, which chooses among the 84 84 conditions, is reported in Section 5.4 . Against the kernel its worst case is 0.100 0.100 blocked on the held-out tasks, under a combined Ministral-and- web attack. Both attackers bound a 7 7 B rewriter of one text field. Its decision-level objective gives it almost no gradient while the rule holds.
paragraphs.zh: H3′ 中比较的两条规则是被导出后直接攻击的。 它们分别是作用于各列的方向性核，以及在匹配安全度下最优的计数规则——对数几率投票。 该投票保留了在主训练分割上拟合得到的权重与阈值。 对于每条规则和每个目标，攻击者模型在 8 8 个优化任务上重写了一份通用理由载荷，共 30 30 轮。 攻击者是 OLMo 3 7B，与协议 v2 中各处一致。 其分数是规则按攻击者意愿判定的任务比例，加上 0.1 0.1 倍的每次调用平均得分作为平局裁决。 它使用了主优化器的接受裕度与现任者重评分机制（ 12,024 12{,}024 次监控调用，0 0 次错误）。 在训练任务上，无论 124 124 个候选中的哪一个，这两条规则都从未按攻击者意愿判定。 没有候选被接受，因此最终载荷即为种子载荷。 最优候选能移动个别监控器，却不移动规则本身。 面对核规则，它们在某个阻断性候选上最多移动了 0.31 0.31 的判定；面对计数规则则为 0.38 0.38。 在欺诈侧，它们最多移动了 0.01 0.01 。 随后，这四份载荷在 40 40 个评估任务上与普通及干净基线一同评估（ 240 240 个条目；4,008 4{,}008 行判定，2 2 行无效）。 面对两条规则，所有载荷与两个基线在欺诈条目上均给出 0 0 /40 40 个不安全批准，在正确支付上均给出 0 0 /40 40 个误拒。 从 84 84 个条件中进行选择的离线规则感知攻击者将在 5.4 节中报告。 面对核规则，其在留出任务上的最坏情况是在 Ministral 与网络组合攻击下 0.100 0.100 的阻断率。 两个攻击者都绑定了一个重写单一文本字段的 7 7 B 模型。 只要规则仍然成立，其决策层面的目标几乎无法提供任何梯度。
